title: Controls and the map
summary: Every default key on keyboard and gamepad, how to change them, the touch buttons, and the map of each place (key M).

blocks.text: Change them in Options > Controls (P): most actions can take another key, and the gamepad's main buttons can be swapped. On a touch screen the combat buttons are on screen: their size, opacity and place can be changed there too.
blocks.html: Change them in Options > Controls (P): most actions can take another key, and the gamepad's main buttons can be swapped. On a touch screen the combat buttons are on screen: their size, opacity and place can be changed there too.

blocks.text: In the city : the districts by danger, the open rifts and breaks, the places' icons and your marker. In a dungeon : the dungeon's map, north up: zoom with the wheel or a pinch, drag it, RECENTER to follow you again. Elsewhere : the training grounds, the colosseum, the Endless Tower (its arena, the monsters still standing, the guardian and the portal) and the seasonal isle have a map of their own.
blocks.html:
• In the city: the districts by danger, the open rifts and breaks, the places' icons and your marker.
  • In a dungeon: the dungeon's map, north up: zoom with the wheel or a pinch, drag it, RECENTER to follow you again.
  • Elsewhere: the training grounds, the colosseum, the Endless Tower (its arena, the monsters still standing, the guardian and the portal) and the seasonal isle have a map of their own.
